{{Top|leg}}
'''Cartography and Surveying''' was a division of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] tasked with surveying [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with an eye towards colonization. At some point, [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Greeley (Galactic Republic)|Greeley]] was in charge of the organization. [[Survey Team 63529]], under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Trask (commander)|Trask]], was assigned to survey the planet [[Trinta]] on an eight-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] long survey.
